replacements.instruction: Agentic CogWriter の reader-facing 表記を常に small caps に統一するため、生の system name を既存の \condAgenticCogWriter macro に置き換える。
replacements.before: In pairwise evaluation, Agentic CogWriter is preferred to one-shot generation, a fixed writing pipeline, and adaptive task planning.
replacements.after: In pairwise evaluation, \condAgenticCogWriter\ is preferred to one-shot generation, a fixed writing pipeline, and adaptive task planning.

replacements.instruction: Experimental Design 冒頭の内容を保ったまま圧縮し、段落末の短い exploratory 系 runt を避ける。
replacements.before: We compare the writing systems under the same task inputs and information policy to address three questions: (1) whether process-level organization improves long-form document quality relative to alternative writing systems, (2) which proposed components contribute to any advantage, and (3) how the writing loop behaves in practice. We include a post-hoc exploratory execution variant.
replacements.after: We compare the writing systems under the same task inputs and information policy to study three questions: whether process-level organization improves document quality, which components contribute to any advantage, and how the writing loop behaves in practice. We also use one post-hoc execution variant as a diagnostic.

replacements.instruction: Pointwise evaluation の段落末で `our setup.` だけが次行に残るのを避けつつ、DoLoMiTes に comparable native score がないという意味を保つ。
replacements.before: WritingBench uses five prompt-specific criteria, HelloBench uses checklist items, and DoLoMiTes has no comparable native score in our setup.
replacements.after: WritingBench uses five prompt-specific criteria, HelloBench uses checklist items, and DoLoMiTes provides no comparable native score.

replacements.instruction: Pairwise evaluation を agreed winner ではなく order-consistent preference として reader-facing に説明する。
replacements.before: We directly compare two responses written for the same prompt using the same quality dimensions and return a winner or tie. LLM judges can exhibit position bias~\citep{zheng2023judging,wang2024fair}, so every pair is evaluated in both presentation orders. We retain a winner only when both orders select the same semantic response; any disagreement, including winner versus tie, is recorded as a tie. Headline win rates condition on comparisons with an agreed winner.
replacements.after: We directly compare two responses written for the same prompt using the same quality dimensions and record which response is preferred, or a tie. LLM judges can exhibit position bias~\citep{zheng2023judging,wang2024fair}, so every pair is evaluated in both presentation orders. We count a preference only when both orders select the same semantic response; any disagreement, including preference versus tie, is recorded as a tie. Headline win rates are computed over these order-consistent comparisons.

replacements.instruction: Exploratory summary の末尾で `confirmatory.` が一語だけ残るのを避け、post-hoc なので exploratory という evidence boundary を保つ。
replacements.before: To summarize the two ablation contrasts across generation runs, we compute an exploratory prompt-level estimate. For each prompt, win, tie, and loss outcomes are mapped to $1$, $1/2$, and $0$, averaged across the three generation runs, and then summarized across benchmarks. We report a prompt-level bootstrap interval and sign test. Because we chose this summary after seeing the main results, we treat it as exploratory, not confirmatory.
replacements.after: To summarize the two ablation contrasts across generation runs, we compute a post-hoc prompt-level estimate. For each prompt, win, tie, and loss outcomes are mapped to $1$, $1/2$, and $0$, averaged across the three generation runs, and then summarized across benchmarks. We report a prompt-level bootstrap interval and sign test, treating this summary as exploratory because it was defined after the main results.

replacements.instruction: Results の agreed winner wording を Experimental Design の order-consistent comparison terminology に揃える。
replacements.before: respectively, when both presentation orders agree on a winner.

replacements.instruction: Worst-case sensitivity の agreed winner wording を order-consistent comparison terminology に揃える。
replacements.before: among comparisons with an agreed winner.

replacements.instruction: Limitations の agreed winner wording を order-consistent comparison terminology に揃え、評価手順を plain language で説明する。
replacements.before: Pairwise win rates condition on comparisons where both presentation orders agree on a winner; Section~\ref{sec:results-effectiveness} also reports unconditional and worst-case missing-output views.
replacements.after: Pairwise win rates are computed over order-consistent comparisons, where both presentation orders select the same response; Section~\ref{sec:results-effectiveness} also reports unconditional and worst-case missing-output views.

比較表内の raw Agentic CogWriter 表記も \condAgenticCogWriter macro に統一し、small caps 表示を全 manuscript で一貫させる。
